value.rationale: Complete sharp two-parameter classification of an ecologically and hydrologically natural compound rainfall response, with a nonmonotone two–one–two peak count when storm separation grows at fixed volume ratio. It cautions against inferring distinct hydrological pathways solely from an observed double peak, because identical kernels with two separated pulses suffice. The specific quantity—the number of maxima of two routed rainfall pulses—directly determines hydrograph shape and possible model attribution rather than being an arbitrary invariant. No statement about empirical attainability or predictive accuracy is made.
